FULL TEXT:
REGULAR MAZDOOR RECRUITMENT EXAMINATION 2025
NOTICE
No.- 39 /R&A Dated: 03rd July, 2026
It is hereby informed that, vide Court Notice No. 12/R&A dated 10.03.2026, the final result of
Regular Mazdoor Recruitment Examination, 2025 for appointment to the post of Regular Mazdoor was
published. Sri Manish Kumar Singh (Roll No. 100161), one of the 171 finally selected candidates had
prayed for extension of joining time beyond the time period specified in his appointment letter.
It is hereby notified to all concerned that the Hon’ble Court have been pleased to grant him
extension of joining time till 29.07.2026. The aforesaid candidate is informed to report for joining in
the Recruitment & Appointment Cell of this Court by 29.07.2026 with all required documents as
mentioned in his appointment letter.
By order of the Court
Sd/- Shiv Gopal Mishra
Registrar General
